custom.subtitle: Tailor-made web applications, backends and integrations for businesses whose processes don't fit off-the-shelf software.

sections.heading: When custom software pays off
paragraphs: Off-the-shelf software covers a lot, until a process belongs to your business and no one else's. That's when spreadsheets, double data entry and workarounds appear. A custom solution models exactly that process and connects the systems you already use.

sections.heading: What we build
items: Web applications and customer portals that work in the browser and on phones.
Backends and APIs that process forms, orders or internal workflows.
Integrations between existing systems, such as online shop, inventory, accounting or CRM.
Digitising paper processes: from a form on the counter to a structured online request.
AI features where they genuinely save work, with EU-hosted models and servers if you prefer.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: We start with a conversation about your process, not about a technology. That leads to a small first scope you can test early. From there we build in small steps and can take care of hosting, maintenance and further development.
We work with TypeScript and modern web frameworks and prefer European hosting providers, so your data stays in the EU.

sections.heading: Your software partner in Heilbronn
paragraphs: Deuy Digital is based in Heilbronn. For businesses in Heilbronn, Neckarsulm and the Heilbronn-Franken region that means short distances and meetings in person. Projects outside the region are handled remotely.

ecommerce.name: E-commerce & Shopify
ecommerce.summary: Online shops and ordering flows that fit your business: on Shopify, custom-built or a combination of both.
ecommerce.title: E-Commerce and Shopify Solutions from Heilbronn
ecommerce.subtitle: Online shops, Shopify development and the technology behind them for retailers and businesses that want to sell online.

sections.heading: Selling online the way your business works
paragraphs: Not every business needs the same online shop. Sometimes a Shopify store is the fastest and most affordable route. Sometimes it takes a custom ordering flow, such as pre-orders with pickup, configurators or B2B ordering with customer-specific prices. We advise you on which route fits your range, budget and team, and then build it.

sections.heading: Shopify development
paragraphs: Shopify gets you online quickly: hosting, payments and checkout are already solved. We take care of everything that should set your store apart.
items: Setup and configuration of new Shopify stores, including products, shipping, taxes and payment methods.
Theme customisation and custom theme development to match your brand.
Custom Shopify apps and extensions for features you can't get off the shelf.
Migration of existing shops to Shopify, with products, customers and redirects.
Headless storefronts when the shop needs to be especially fast or especially individual.

sections.heading: Custom e-commerce solutions
paragraphs: Where a standard shop isn't enough, we build the missing parts or the whole solution.
items: Custom ordering and enquiry flows such as click & collect, pre-orders or configurators.
Connections to payment providers, shipping providers, inventory, accounting and newsletter tools.
Content and product data in a CMS your team can maintain itself.
Fast load times, technical SEO and local visibility.
Hosting in Europe plus ongoing operations and further development.

sections.heading: From the shop floor to an online channel
paragraphs: For Seel Schreibwaren in Heilbronn we took a paper process online: parents upload their child's school list and choose pickup or delivery, and the shop receives everything as a structured request. Solutions like this come from understanding how the shop actually works, not just from installing a shopping cart.

sections.heading: E-commerce and Shopify partner in Heilbronn
paragraphs: We are a software team from Heilbronn and are happy to come to you for a first conversation, in Heilbronn, Neckarsulm and the Heilbronn-Franken region. You work directly with the developers who build your shop and solve the special cases too.

ai.name: AI solutions
ai.summary: AI that takes real work off your hands: reading documents, answering questions, automating workflows, as in our own product, Vertragbot.
ai.title: AI Solutions from Heilbronn
ai.subtitle: We build AI into your software and workflows where it noticeably saves work, and in a way that keeps your data in Europe.

sections.heading: AI that helps in day-to-day work
paragraphs: Most businesses don't need their own AI model. They need an answer to a simple question: which recurring work can AI take off our hands? Often it's documents that have to be read, requests that have to be sorted, or information that has to be gathered from several sources. We find those spots with you and build the right solution.

sections.heading: What we build
items: Document analysis: automatically reading contracts, invoices or forms and capturing the key details in structured form.
Assistants and chatbots that answer questions based on your own documents and data.
Automation of recurring tasks, such as classifying requests, summarising texts or transferring data.
AI features in existing software, websites and online shops.
Connecting your systems to AI assistants, for example through an MCP server.
Operation with AI models and servers in the EU when data protection requires it.

sections.heading: How we approach it
paragraphs: We start small: with one concrete use case and a prototype that shows you whether the AI works reliably enough in your day-to-day. Only once that convinces do we extend the solution and integrate it into your systems. And we'll say so openly when a simple rule or a form is a better solution than AI.

sections.heading: AI development on site in Heilbronn
paragraphs: Deuy Digital is a software team from Heilbronn. We work with businesses from Heilbronn, Neckarsulm and the Heilbronn-Franken region in person, from the first conversation through the prototype to ongoing operation.

reference.heading: Our own AI product: Vertragbot
reference.body: We don't only use AI for clients. We also run our own product on it. With Vertragbot, users upload existing contracts, the AI extracts parties, terms and notice periods and answers questions about the contract; signing happens right in the app. Vertragbot runs on the web, iOS and Android, on European servers with AI from the EU. What we learn there goes into every client project.

seel.name: Seel Schreibwaren
seel.summary: Website, CMS, custom form backend, hosting and ongoing operations — since 2022.
seel.subtitle: A stationery shop in the heart of Heilbronn — the website, the CMS, a custom backend, hosted in Europe.

client.heading: The client
client.body: Seel Schreibwaren sells stationery, office, art and craft supplies in Heilbronn's city centre. They wanted a website they could keep up to date themselves — new arrivals, events, the product range — without calling a developer for every change.

built.heading: What we built
items: A fast, statically generated website (Next.js) in German and English, with pages for news, events, the product range, services, the team, careers and more.
A self-hosted headless CMS so the shop edits its own content. Edits are published automatically on a schedule, and every image is optimised at build time.
The school-list service: a paper process turned into an online one — more on that below.
Local SEO: dedicated landing pages for Heilbronn and 19 surrounding towns, plus structured metadata on every page.

items.text: School-list service: parents order the school's stationery list online
Migration to TypeScript and the Next.js App Router
Move to Scaleway with Terraform, new school-list backend, CMS upgrade with a verified data migration, English version

hosting.heading: Hosted in Europe
hosting.body: The whole stack — website, CMS and backend — runs on Scaleway, a European cloud provider under EU jurisdiction. Customer and form data never leave Europe, and nothing depends on a US hyperscaler. Digital sovereignty by default, not as an add-on.

schoolList.heading: From paper list to online order
paragraphs: Every summer, schools in the region hand out a list of the stationery each child needs for the coming year. Parents used to bring that sheet into the shop.

Now they photograph or scan the list and upload it on seel-schreibwaren.de, add the details that matter — the child's name, left- or right-handed, colour and favourite-animal wishes, whether items should be labelled — and choose pickup or delivery. The shop receives everything in one email, assembles the set, and the parent gets an automatic confirmation.
A small change for parents, a big one for the shop: the busiest weeks of the year now arrive as structured requests instead of paper sheets at the counter.
